newsitem.title: USA: Deere Capital Corp Q1 net income down.
newsitem.headline: Deere Capital Corp Q1 net income down.

text.p: Deere & Co said Tuesday that its John Deere Capital Corp credit subsidiary posted net income for the fiscal first quarter of $29.7 million, down from $32.3 million a year ago.

Higher income from a 15 percent increase in the average balance of receivables and leases financed was more than offset by lower financing spreads and higher expenditures associated with several growth initiatives.
Financing receivable and lease acquisition volumes for the quarter increased 29 percent compared to a year ago primarily due to the increased sales of John Deere equipment.
Net receivables and leases financed by John Deere Capital were $5.79 billion at January 31, 1997 compared with $5.01 billion one year ago.
